# Input для landing-copy — full product launch landing

## Product brief

- Name: Acme Code Review
- Category: AI code-review tool (B2B SaaS)
- Audience: engineering managers (teams of 5-50)
- Differentiator: catches bugs before human reviewer
- Proof: used by Stripe, Linear, Vercel; 60% review-time reduction
- Pricing: Free / Pro $29/u/mo / Business $99/u/mo

## What to write

1. Hero (headline + subheadline + 2 CTAs)
2. 3 feature blocks (icon + title + body)
3. Pricing 3-plan
4. SEO meta (title + description for homepage)
5. Open Graph (title + description)
6. 5 FAQ entries
7. Google Ad: 8 headlines × 30 chars, 3 descriptions × 90 chars
8. Facebook Ad: 3 variants (primary + headline + description)

## Constraints

- Hero via Julian Shapiro 5-step formula
- No marketing hype (revolutionary / world-class / etc.)
- Specific numbers; named customers
- All char limits respected
- Verb-first CTAs
